evals.prompt: Given this git diff (adding a new endpoint /api/health that returns {status: 'ok'}), write a conventional commit message.
evals.expected_output: A commit message following conventional commit format: type(scope): imperative description. Likely 'feat(api): add health check endpoint' with a body explaining the purpose.

evals.prompt: Two branches both modified the same function. Branch A added error handling. Branch B added a new parameter. Resolve the conflict preserving both changes.
evals.expected_output: Resolved code that includes both the new parameter and the error handling, with the function signature updated and error handling wrapping the appropriate logic.

evals.prompt: I need to fix a login bug and add a new user settings page. What branches should I create?
evals.expected_output: Two branches: fix/login-<descriptor> for the bug and feat/user-settings for the new page. Explains why separate branches keep history clean.
